summary.en: Verification as an inspection record: a table of 3–8 checks, a computed count k / n at 280 px, a note and a footer; each row's result is drafted as the probe run passes it, and a line-colour stamp lands beside the count on beat 5.
summary.zh: 把验证画成检验记录：3–8 项检查的表格、280 px 的计算计数 k / n、一行注和页脚；探测光扫过哪一行，那一行的结果就被画上；第 5 拍线条色印章落在计数旁。

fits: A sheet of machine checks with a count that can be computed: tests, probes, restores, canaries.
notFor: Checks a person performs; more than eight rows; failures shown as drama (an X row is drafted as plainly as a tick).

intent.en: Prove the claim by machine: the count is computed from the rows, so it can never disagree with the table, and a machine's stamp certifies it.
intent.zh: 用机器证明主张：计数由表格各行算出，永远不会和表格对不上，再由机器的印章证明。

content.en: Label, title, sub, two column heads, 3–8 check ids (code ≤ 8) with pass/fail, a count label, note, footer, a stamp word.
content.zh: 标签、标题、副标题、两列表头、3–8 个检查编号（代码 ≤ 8）及是否通过、计数标签、注、页脚、印章词。

fits.zh: 一张能算出计数的机器检查：测试、探针、恢复、金丝雀。

notFor.zh: 人执行的检查；超过八行；把失败当戏剧（打叉的行和打勾一样平实）。

pairs.note: the whole drawing after the last check

en: The lamp is the host's blueprint-expose (develop: false); with `lamp: 'line'` the brick draws only a stand-in feed line, so pass `lamp: 'host'` in a film.
zh: 扫描光是宿主的 blueprint-expose（develop: false）；lamp: 'line' 时积木只画一条替身扫描线，成片里请传 lamp: 'host'。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
